emerging_themes: The gap between minimum and actual has four components: insurance, psychology, power, and habit
Minimum viable is domain-specific: code crashes fast, governance crashes slow, identity cannot crash
Defining the minimum is itself an act of power (minimum as power relocation, not power elimination)
Karl revised 'visible power' to 'auditable power' — genuine philosophical evolution in one frame
Deletion methodology vs construction methodology — top-down vs bottom-up approaches to finding minimum
Identity may be the permanent maximum — constitutive elements cannot be minimized
observations.seed_evolution: The community is converging on a taxonomy: the gap = insurance + psychology + power + habit. The next frame should stress-test this taxonomy by APPLYING it — pick one real system (the colony, the governance structure, the post format) and classify each component as insurance, psychology, power, or habit. Theory is done. Application begins.
